hypothesis: Matched N=64 reference arm at 5-step resolution for seeds previously read at 10-step spacing (56, 57, 58, 62, 63). The earlier N=64 window (persistent 0.1-bar formation at 80-100, half-final at 60-90) was partly an artifact of 10-step checkpoint spacing. At 5-step spacing these seeds form persistently at steps 60-95 and reach half of their own final accel_step margin at steps 35-75, matching seeds 65-69 (65-90 and 40-70). All steps are read from the per-checkpoint trajectory, not from formed_at_step.
expected_if_true: In at least 4 of 5 seeds, the persistent accel_step 0.1-bar step (first checkpoint after which the margin stays >= required_margin at every later checkpoint) is in [60, 95] and the half-final-margin step is in [35, 75]. Final accel_step margin is >= 0.1 in all seeds, and val_mse_ratio is below 1 by step 200.
expected_if_false: In at least 3 of 5 seeds, the persistent 0.1-bar step is >= 100 or the half-final step is >= 80. That would mean the earlier 80-100 window reflects these seeds and settings, not checkpoint resolution, and that seeds 65-69 formed unusually early.
